```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```


```{r}
#identische Bennung der Patient-ID  Bindestrich
colnames(BRCA_methylation_data_original) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(BRCA_methylation_data_original))
```

```{r}
#Subset des Annotation Dataframes mit dem Type
#drop=FALSE behält die Dimensionen
tissue_types <- BRCA_sample_sheet[,7, drop=FALSE]
```


```{r}
#Library pheatmap laden
library(pheatmap)

#Pearson-Korrelation zwischen den Patienten ausrechnen
patient_correlation_each_with_everyone <- cor(BRCA_methylation_data_original)

#Farbgebung für tumour tissue rot und für solid tissue blau
annotation_color <- list(Type=c(`Primary solid Tumor`='red', `Solid Tissue Normal` = 'blue'))

#Heatmap der Korrelation, geclustered mit complete linkage, Annotationen zum tissue Type
pheatmap(patient_correlation_each_with_everyone, 
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = FALSE, 
         annotation_col = tissue_types, 
         annotation_row = tissue_types, 
         annotation_colors=annotation_color, 
         color=rev(heat.colors(100)))
```
